titleEn: Maximize the Number of Partitions After Operations
title: 执行操作后的最大分割数量
summary: 至多把字符串一个位置改成任意小写字母，然后反复删除含不同字符不超过 k 的最长前缀；求最多能得到多少段。
insight: 原分割之前的完整段不会受位置 i 的修改影响。预处理每个起点在未修改字符串中的贪心后缀段数，以及每个位置所属原段的起点。对每个修改和字母，只需借助 26 个字符的下一出现位置求出受影响的一到两段边界，随后无缝接上预处理后缀。
pitfalls: 必须每次取最长合法前缀
修改字符可能恰好在新段的起点，因而影响连续两段
相同字符的首次出现被改掉时要寻找其下一次出现
k 等于二十六时永远只有一段
避免长度一万的递归栈

solutions.title: 下一出现位置与前后缀枚举
solutions.idea: 固定字母表下枚举修改，并在常数规模数组中选择第 k+1 个首次出现位置。
steps: 用第 k+1 小首次出现位置计算 suffixPartitions[i]
扫描原字符串记录每个位置的 segmentStart 与 prefixPartitions
枚举 changedIndex 和二十六种 replacement
调整旧字符与新字符的首次出现位置
排序二十六个首次位置得到第一条新边界
若边界落在修改位置，再同样计算受影响的第二段
拼接不受影响前缀、受影响段与 suffixPartitions

code.java: class Solution { private int n,limitDistinct;private int[][] next;private final int[] work=new int[26];private int cut(int start,int changedIndex,int oldLetter,int replacement){System.arraycopy(next[start],0,work,0,26);if(changedIndex>=0&&replacement!=oldLetter){if(work[oldLetter]==changedIndex)work[oldLetter]=next[changedIndex+1][oldLetter];if(changedIndex>=start&&changedIndex<work[replacement])work[replacement]=changedIndex;}Arrays.sort(work);return limitDistinct<26?work[limitDistinct]:n;}public int maxPartitionsAfterOperations(String s,int k){n=s.length();limitDistinct=k;next=new int[n+1][26];Arrays.fill(next[n],n);for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){System.arraycopy(next[i+1],0,next[i],0,26);next[i][s.charAt(i)-'a']=i;}int[] suffix=new int[n+1];for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){int boundary=cut(i,-1,0,0);suffix[i]=1+(boundary<n?suffix[boundary]:0);}int[] segmentStart=new int[n],prefixPartitions=new int[n];int mask=0,start=0,parts=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int bit=1<<(s.charAt(i)-'a');if(Integer.bitCount(mask|bit)>k){parts++;start=i;mask=bit;}else mask|=bit;segmentStart[i]=start;prefixPartitions[i]=parts;}int answer=suffix[0];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int oldLetter=s.charAt(i)-'a';for(int replacement=0;replacement<26;replacement++){int firstBoundary=cut(segmentStart[i],i,oldLetter,replacement),candidate;if(firstBoundary<=i){int secondBoundary=cut(i,i,oldLetter,replacement);candidate=prefixPartitions[i]+2+(secondBoundary<n?suffix[secondBoundary]:0);}else candidate=prefixPartitions[i]+1+(firstBoundary<n?suffix[firstBoundary]:0);answer=Math.max(answer,candidate);}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private var n=0;private var limitDistinct=0;private lateinit var next:Array<IntArray>;private val work=IntArray(26);private fun cut(start:Int,changedIndex:Int,oldLetter:Int,replacement:Int):Int{next[start].copyInto(work);if(changedIndex>=0&&replacement!=oldLetter){if(work[oldLetter]==changedIndex)work[oldLetter]=next[changedIndex+1][oldLetter];if(changedIndex>=start&&changedIndex<work[replacement])work[replacement]=changedIndex};work.sort();return if(limitDistinct<26)work[limitDistinct] else n};fun maxPartitionsAfterOperations(s:String,k:Int):Int{n=s.length;limitDistinct=k;next=Array(n+1){IntArray(26){n}};for(i in n-1 downTo 0){next[i+1].copyInto(next[i]);next[i][s[i]-'a']=i};val suffix=IntArray(n+1);for(i in n-1 downTo 0){val boundary=cut(i,-1,0,0);suffix[i]=1+if(boundary<n)suffix[boundary] else 0};val segmentStart=IntArray(n);val prefixPartitions=IntArray(n);var mask=0;var start=0;var parts=0;for(i in s.indices){val bit=1 shl (s[i]-'a');if(Integer.bitCount(mask or bit)>k){parts++;start=i;mask=bit}else mask=mask or bit;segmentStart[i]=start;prefixPartitions[i]=parts};var answer=suffix[0];for(i in s.indices){val oldLetter=s[i]-'a';for(replacement in 0 until 26){val firstBoundary=cut(segmentStart[i],i,oldLetter,replacement);val candidate=if(firstBoundary<=i){val secondBoundary=cut(i,i,oldLetter,replacement);prefixPartitions[i]+2+if(secondBoundary<n)suffix[secondBoundary] else 0}else prefixPartitions[i]+1+if(firstBoundary<n)suffix[firstBoundary] else 0;answer=maxOf(answer,candidate)}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int n,limitDistinct;vector<array<int,26>> next;array<int,26> work;int cut(int start,int changedIndex,int oldLetter,int replacement){work=next[start];if(changedIndex>=0&&replacement!=oldLetter){if(work[oldLetter]==changedIndex)work[oldLetter]=next[changedIndex+1][oldLetter];if(changedIndex>=start&&changedIndex<work[replacement])work[replacement]=changedIndex;}sort(work.begin(),work.end());return limitDistinct<26?work[limitDistinct]:n;}public:int maxPartitionsAfterOperations(string s,int k){n=s.size();limitDistinct=k;next.assign(n+1,{});next[n].fill(n);for(int i=n-1;i>=0;--i){next[i]=next[i+1];next[i][s[i]-'a']=i;}vector<int> suffix(n+1),segmentStart(n),prefixPartitions(n);for(int i=n-1;i>=0;--i){int boundary=cut(i,-1,0,0);suffix[i]=1+(boundary<n?suffix[boundary]:0);}int mask=0,start=0,parts=0;for(int i=0;i<n;++i){int bit=1<<(s[i]-'a');if(__builtin_popcount(mask|bit)>k){++parts;start=i;mask=bit;}else mask|=bit;segmentStart[i]=start;prefixPartitions[i]=parts;}int answer=suffix[0];for(int i=0;i<n;++i){int oldLetter=s[i]-'a';for(int replacement=0;replacement<26;++replacement){int firstBoundary=cut(segmentStart[i],i,oldLetter,replacement),candidate;if(firstBoundary<=i){int secondBoundary=cut(i,i,oldLetter,replacement);candidate=prefixPartitions[i]+2+(secondBoundary<n?suffix[secondBoundary]:0);}else candidate=prefixPartitions[i]+1+(firstBoundary<n?suffix[firstBoundary]:0);answer=max(answer,candidate);}}return answer;} };
